title: Sunday · sliced
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The Scroll arc's Sunday: the bay, drawn to be read wide, with the aggregator's slice lines marked through it in thin red — where the phone will cut it. The reader sees what the phone loses.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the bay from the bluff, the widest composition the strip has, gulls, the dock, the ridge. And across it, three thin vertical red lines: the slice marks. The gulls fall between them.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a very wide view of a bay from a bluff with gulls, a dock and a distant ridge, and three thin vertical red lines drawn across the image like crop marks, no words
image.notes: The slice marks are part of the art. The one spot of red.

panels.name: Wide

panels.composition: Tier 2: one slice, as the phone would show it: a square of water, no gulls, no dock, the ridge cut off. Bordered in red.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a square crop of bay water with nothing in it bordered by a thin red line, no words

panels.name: Between

panels.composition: Tier 3: the same bay without the lines. The gulls. The dock. Everything. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, the same very wide bay from a bluff with gulls and a dock and a distant ridge, whole, no lines, no words

panels.name: Wide again

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The slice marks in red. What the phone loses.
